column1: # Per-ROM metadata facts across the full 287-ROM corpus, 2026-08-05.
# Produced by examples/probe_rom_facts.rs (one pass, ~7s wall clock).
# TWO KINDS OF FACT, and reading them together is the point:
#   code_span / containers  PERMANENT properties of the image. They do
#                           not move as fn64 improves, so they bound what
#   table_outcome           CURRENT BUILD capability. Moves as descriptor
#   containers    none 233  Gzip 39  Mio0 10  Gzip+Mio0 3  Gzip+Yaz0 2
# THE JOINT VIEW -- of the 239 ROMs with no usable table:
#   217  COMPLETE: single-bank, no overlay geometry to recover
#    22  MISS: multi-span, code the overlay search did not account for
# So the real overlay-discovery work list is 22 ROMs. Earlier planning in
# this session put it at 229 -- a 10x overcount -- because 'no table
# found' was not separable from 'no table exists'.
# Corroboration: OoT reports Yaz0:1457, matching the 1457/1510 compressed
# dmadata entries measured independently. Mario Kart 64 reports Mio0:3354,
# matching its separately counted MIO0 stream total.
# CAVEAT: SingleBank is a weak signal, not proof of absence. WM2000 is
# SingleBank at 1.00 and HAS overlays -- they load from inside the same
# span. Sound in aggregate, unsound as a per-ROM verdict.
